moderation.title: Keep the room feeling good.
moderation.text: Small, deliberate controls for the moments that need a little backup. Every change is saved to the bot's live configuration.
moderation.introText: Start with the essentials, then tune thresholds below when you know the room’s rhythm.
moderation.premiumActiveUntil: AI image moderation is active until {date}
moderation.premiumPerk: AI image moderation is a premium perk
moderation.premiumActiveText: Every image in this server is scored by fal.ai's NSFW model and removed when it crosses the threshold.
moderation.premiumUpsell: Upgrade this server to run fal.ai NSFW detection on every image. Billed monthly, cancel by not renewing.
moderation.rulesDetail: Toggle only the responses you want Niko to handle.
moderation.scamNote: The scam image filter is still in early testing and may have some reliability issues.
moderation.wordsDetail: Niko handles messages containing these words when the “Blocked words” switch above is on.
moderation.emptyWordsBefore: Add a word below, or manage the same list with
moderation.responseHint: What Niko does with a message that uses a blocked word
moderation.maskHint: Replaces each blocked word; a single character repeats to match its length
moderation.censorNoteBefore: Censoring deletes the flagged message and reposts the text through a webhook in that channel using the member's name and avatar, so Niko needs
moderation.censorNoteAfter: in the channels you want censored. If the webhook cannot be created the message is deleted instead.
moderation.matchNoteBefore: Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, like Discord: blocking
moderation.matchNoteMiddle: leaves “category” alone. End a word with
moderation.matchNoteAnywhere: to match it anywhere. Separators between letters are ignored, so
moderation.presetsDetail: Turn on ready-made filters for slurs and other content. Each one is a regular expression, so it also catches the spellings people use to slip past a word list.
moderation.presetsUnavailable: Preset filters are unavailable right now — reload the page to try again.
moderation.presetsNote: Presets run with the same response as the word list above: delete the message, or censor and repost it. They are regular expressions rather than plain keywords, so they also tolerate leet substitutions, letters separated by spaces or punctuation, repeated letters, self-censored letters, look-alike unicode characters and fullwidth forms — while leaving ordinary words such as “class”, “analysis” and “spices” untouched. Matching is deliberately aggressive: a term is blocked wherever it stands on its own, so a place name that looks like one trips the slur preset.
moderation.thresholdsDetail: These limits apply across the server.
moderation.newAccountHint: Act on members whose account is younger than this; 0 turns the filter off
moderation.lockdownSlowmodeHint: Applied to every channel when the anti-raid action is “Lockdown”
moderation.antinukeDetail: Niko follows audit-log actions from one moderator and responds when a limit is crossed. Every one of these is also editable with /automod in Discord.
moderation.intervalHint: The window these actions are counted in
moderation.extTitle: Limit what new members can trigger
moderation.extDetail: Detects coordinated interaction floods from freshly joined members and abuse of user-installed apps.
moderation.floodMembersHint: Newly joined members triggering interactions at the same time
moderation.newForHint: How long after joining a member still counts as new
